title: Property Axiom System in Dimensional-Structural Describability — Reproducibility Package
description: Standard-library Python reproduction and proof-audit companion for the finite constructions in the generalized Property Axiom System in Dimensional-Structural Describability. The package reproduces the two primitive-axiom independence countermodels, a one-input nontrivial model, finite status separation, Stage-2/3/4 first-branch witnesses by exhaustive carrier-bijection comparison, a simple-summary collision with a strict-core-isomorphism obstruction, an optional-representation separation witness, and a finite forward-map composition check. General set-theoretic proofs remain in the manuscript. Axis realization, line/rank, bilinear, normal, and cyclic-axis structures are intentionally excluded from the universal property core and remain part of the separate realized-axis specialization.
